_comment: Chapter 7 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F31, Kai's last stand (trust 3+: he holds the door, two potions; else one potion).

text.zh_TW: 王座前室的大門前，凱停下腳步，把劍插在地上。
text.en: At the great door of the throne antechamber, Kai stops and plants his sword in the floor.

text.zh_TW: 凱：「上面的路，你一個人走。下面追上來的，我一個也不放過。」他把兩瓶藥水塞給你。「我說過——我欠你一條命。今天還給你。」
text.en: Kai: "You take the way up alone. Whatever comes up behind you, none of it gets past me." He presses two potions into your hands. "I told you. I owe you a life. Today I pay it back."

label.en: "Come back alive, Kai. Mira's waiting for you."

text.zh_TW: 凱：「……不管上面有什麼，我都跟著你。」他遞給你一瓶藥水。「別死在我前面。」
text.en: Kai: "...Whatever is up there, I'm with you." He hands you a potion. "Don't die before I do."
